title: Bob Wisman Joins First United Bank & Trust as Mortgage Relationship Manager
summary: Scott Hostetler, Managing Director of Mortgage Solutions at First United Bank & Trust, is pleased to announce the addition of Bob Wisman as a Mortgage Relationship Manager serving north-central West Virginia.
body_markdown:
Scott Hostetler, Managing Director of Mortgage Solutions at[First United Bank & Trust](http://mybank.com/) , is pleased to announce the addition of Bob Wisman as a Mortgage Relationship Manager serving north-central West Virginia.


In his new role, Wisman will help individuals and families navigate the home financing process, providing personalized guidance and trusted support from application through closing. His expertise and commitment to customer service will help clients make informed decisions as they pursue homeownership and other residential lending opportunities.


Based in Morgantown, Wisman brings more than 30 years of financial services experience to First United. Throughout his career, he has built a reputation for developing strong client relationships, delivering exceptional service, and consistently achieving business growth objectives. His diverse background includes residential and commercial lending, business development, sales, and marketing.


Prior to joining First United, Wisman served in mortgage lending and business development roles, where he assisted clients with a wide range of financing solutions while cultivating long-term community and business relationships.


“Bob’s extensive lending experience, deep knowledge of our market, and genuine commitment to helping people achieve their financial goals make him an outstanding addition to our mortgage team,” said Hostetler. “He has built a career on trust, service, and relationship-building, and we are excited to welcome him to First United as we continue assisting clients throughout north-central West Virginia with their home financing needs.”


Wisman earned a Bachelor of Science in Mechanical Engineering from West Virginia University with a minor in Business Administration.


Wisman will be located at the First United Bank & Trust Suncrest Community Office, and can be reached at304-291-2825 orbwisman@MyBank.com . (NMLS #: 2773788)


First United Corporation operates one full-service commercial bank, First United Bank & Trust. The Bank has a network of community offices in Garrett, Allegany, Washington, and Frederick counties in Maryland, as well as Mineral, Berkeley, and Monongalia counties in West Virginia. First United’s website can be located at MyBank.com. As of 9/30/2026, the corporation posted assets of $2.1 billion.
